args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified as rolled out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that root cause investigation is ongoing. The on-call engineer was paged.
